newsitem.title: JAPAN: FORECAST - Japan Oct c/a surplus seen down 9.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Japan Oct c/a surplus seen down 9.6 pct.

text.p: Japan's current account surplus, the broadest measure of trade in goods and services, is expected to have fallen by about 9.6 percent in October from a year earlier to 413.1 billion yen, according to an average of forecasts by private economic research institutions.
The current account surplus has been falling every month on a year-on-year basis since December 1994. The surplus totalled 457.1 billion yen in October 1995.
The October data is due to be announced at 8.50 a.m. on Wednesday (2350 GMT on Tuesday).

The year-on-year drop in September was 35.6 percent, and the economists said the expected slowing of the pace of the drop in October would be due mainly to a slight fall in the trade surplus that month.
